name: dify-aio
description: Dify is a self-hosted AI application platform for agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, tools, model-provider integrations, and observability. All-In-One Unraid Edition `dify-aio` packages the Dify API, workers, web UI, plugin daemon, code sandbox, SSRF proxy, Nginx, PostgreSQL with pgvector, and Redis into one practical Unraid-first container. Quick Install (Beginners) 1. Install this template and leave [code]Web UI Port[/code] and [code]AppData[/code] at their defaults unless you already have a port conflict. 2. Start the container and give first boot a few minutes. The wrapper initializes bundled PostgreSQL, pgvector, Redis, generated secrets, local storage, the sandbox, plugin daemon, and the Dify services. 3. Open the Web UI and create the first admin account. You can optionally set [code]Initial Admin Password[/code] before first boot, but it is not required. 4. Add model-provider credentials inside Dify first. For a reverse proxy or published apps, set [code]Public URL[/code] to your external HTTPS URL and restart. 5. Keep Advanced View defaults for the easiest install. The bundled database, cache, vector store, local file storage, sandbox, and SSRF proxy are already wired together. Power Users (Advanced View) - Advanced View exposes external PostgreSQL-compatible databases, Redis, object storage, vector databases, SMTP/mail, plugin storage, observability, CORS/CSP, sandbox, proxy, token expiry, indexing, cleanup, and broader upstream Dify environment controls. - If you switch a backend selector such as [code]VECTOR_STORE[/code], [code]STORAGE_TYPE[/code], [code]DB_TYPE[/code], or internal service toggles, configure the matching companion fields for that backend. - Blank secret fields generate and persist values in [code]/appdata/config/generated.env[/code]. Explicit Unraid template values override generated secrets, and [code]/appdata/config/extra.env[/code] remains the final advanced override escape hatch. - [code]CHECK_UPDATE_URL[/code] is blank by default to avoid outbound update checks unless you intentionally opt in. Important Notes - Dify is a heavier multi-service stack. Plan for at least 2 CPU cores and 4 GiB RAM, with more memory for real indexing, workflow, or model-heavy workloads. - Public exposure should sit behind a trusted reverse proxy with TLS. Review sandbox/network settings before allowing untrusted users to run code or tools. - External vector stores, object storage, SMTP, and model providers are optional but real production deployments may need them.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Dify Web UI and API gateway port.

variables.name: Public URL
variables.description: Optional external base URL such as https://dify.example.com. Used to default Dify console, app, trigger, WebSocket, and file URLs.

variables.name: Initial Admin Password
variables.description: Optional initial admin password. Dify limits this value to 30 characters. Leave blank to set the admin account during first-run setup.

variables.name: Deploy Environment
variables.description: Dify deployment environment mode. Keep PRODUCTION for normal Unraid installs.

variables.name: Dify Update Check URL
variables.description: Optional Dify update-check endpoint. Leave blank to disable outbound update checks for privacy-focused or offline installs.

variables.name: Secret Key
variables.description: Dify application secret key. Leave blank to generate and persist one on first boot. Changing this after setup invalidates encrypted credentials and sessions.

variables.name: Use Internal PostgreSQL
variables.description: Use the bundled PostgreSQL 15 database with pgvector. Set false only when using an external PostgreSQL-compatible database.

variables.name: Dify Env: CELERY_AUTO_SCALE
variables.description: Flag indicating whether to enable autoscaling of Celery workers. Autoscaling is useful when tasks are CPU intensive and can be dynamically allocated and deallocated based on the workload. When autoscaling is enabled, the maximum and minimum number of workers can be specified....

variables.name: Dify Env: SQLALCHEMY_POOL_RECYCLE

variables.name: Dify Env: SQLALCHEMY_ECHO

variables.name: Dify Env: SQLALCHEMY_POOL_TIMEOUT

variables.name: Dify Env: POSTGRES_MAX_CONNECTIONS
variables.description: Maximum number of connections to the database Default is 100 Reference: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/runtime-config-connection.html#GUC-MAX-CONNECTIONS

variables.name: Dify Env: POSTGRES_SHARED_BUFFERS
variables.description: Sets the amount of shared memory used for postgres's shared buffers. Default is 128MB Recommended value: 25% of available memory Reference: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/runtime-config-resource.html#GUC-SHARED-BUFFERS

variables.name: Dify Env: POSTGRES_WORK_MEM
variables.description: Sets the amount of memory used by each database worker for working space. Default is 4MB Reference: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/runtime-config-resource.html#GUC-WORK-MEM

variables.name: Dify Env: POSTGRES_MAINTENANCE_WORK_MEM
variables.description: Sets the amount of memory reserved for maintenance activities. Default is 64MB Reference: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/runtime-config-resource.html#GUC-MAINTENANCE-WORK-MEM

variables.name: Dify Env: POSTGRES_EFFECTIVE_CACHE_SIZE
variables.description: Sets the planner's assumption about the effective cache size. Default is 4096MB Reference: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/runtime-config-query.html#GUC-EFFECTIVE-CACHE-SIZE

variables.name: Dify Env: POSTGRES_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT
variables.description: Sets the maximum allowed duration of any statement before termination. Default is 0 (no timeout). Reference: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/runtime-config-client.html#GUC-STATEMENT-TIMEOUT A value of 0 prevents the server from timing out statements.

variables.name: Dify Env: POSTGRES_IDLE_IN_TRANSACTION_SESSION_TIMEOUT
variables.description: Sets the maximum allowed duration of any idle in-transaction session before termination. Default is 0 (no timeout). Reference: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/runtime-config-client.html#GUC-IDLE-IN-TRANSACTION-SESSION-TIMEOUT A value of 0 prevents the server from...

variables.name: Dify Env: MYSQL_MAX_CONNECTIONS
variables.description: MySQL Performance Configuration Maximum number of connections to MySQL Default is 1000

variables.name: Dify Env: MYSQL_INNODB_BUFFER_POOL_SIZE
variables.description: InnoDB buffer pool size Default is 512M Recommended value: 70-80% of available memory for dedicated MySQL server Reference: https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.0/en/innodb-parameters.html#sysvar_innodb_buffer_pool_size

variables.name: Dify Env: MYSQL_INNODB_LOG_FILE_SIZE
variables.description: InnoDB log file size Default is 128M Reference: https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.0/en/innodb-parameters.html#sysvar_innodb_log_file_size

variables.name: Dify Env: MYSQL_INNODB_FLUSH_LOG_AT_TRX_COMMIT
variables.description: InnoDB flush log at transaction commit Default is 2 (flush to OS cache, sync every second) Options: 0 (no flush), 1 (flush and sync), 2 (flush to OS cache) Reference: https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.0/en/innodb-parameters.html#sysvar_innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit

variables.name: Dify Env: UPLOAD_FILE_EXTENSION_BLACKLIST
variables.description: Comma-separated list of file extensions blocked from upload for security reasons. Extensions should be lowercase without dots (e.g., exe,bat,sh,dll). Empty by default to allow all file types. Recommended: exe,bat,cmd,com,scr,vbs,ps1,msi,dll

variables.name: Dify Env: ATTACHMENT_IMAGE_FILE_SIZE_LIMIT
variables.description: Maximum allowed image file size for attachments in megabytes, default 2.

variables.name: Dify Env: ATTACHMENT_IMAGE_DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT
variables.description: Timeout for downloading image attachments in seconds, default 60.

variables.name: Dify Env: ETL_TYPE
variables.description: ETL type, support: `dify`, `Unstructured` `dify` Dify's proprietary file extraction scheme `Unstructured` Unstructured.io file extraction scheme

variables.name: Dify Env: UNSTRUCTURED_API_URL
variables.description: Unstructured API path and API key, needs to be configured when ETL_TYPE is Unstructured Or using Unstructured for document extractor node for pptx. For example: http://unstructured:8000/general/v0/general

variables.name: Dify Env: PROMPT_GENERATION_MAX_TOKENS
variables.description: The maximum number of tokens allowed for prompt generation. This setting controls the upper limit of tokens that can be used by the LLM when generating a prompt in the prompt generation tool. Default: 512 tokens.

variables.name: Dify Env: CODE_GENERATION_MAX_TOKENS
variables.description: The maximum number of tokens allowed for code generation. This setting controls the upper limit of tokens that can be used by the LLM when generating code in the code generation tool. Default: 1024 tokens.

variables.name: Dify Env: MULTIMODAL_SEND_FORMAT
variables.description: The format of the image/video/audio/document sent when the multi-modal model is input, the default is base64, optional url. The delay of the call in url mode will be lower than that in base64 mode. It is generally recommended to use the more compatible base64 mode. If...

variables.description: Upload video file size limit, default 100M.

variables.name: Dify Env: UPLOAD_AUDIO_FILE_SIZE_LIMIT
variables.description: Upload audio file size limit, default 50M.

variables.name: Dify Env: SENTRY_DSN
variables.description: Sentry Configuration Used for application monitoring and error log tracking.

variables.name: Dify Env: PLUGIN_SENTRY_ENABLED
variables.description: Plugin_daemon Service Sentry DSN address, default is empty, when empty, all monitoring information is not reported to Sentry. If not set, Sentry error reporting will be disabled.

variables.name: Dify Env: NOTION_INTEGRATION_TYPE
variables.description: Configure as "public" or "internal". Since Notion's OAuth redirect URL only supports HTTPS, if deploying locally, please use Notion's internal integration.

variables.name: Dify Env: NOTION_CLIENT_SECRET
variables.description: Notion OAuth client secret (used for public integration type)

variables.name: Dify Env: NOTION_CLIENT_ID
variables.description: Notion OAuth client id (used for public integration type)

variables.name: Dify Env: NOTION_INTERNAL_SECRET
variables.description: Notion internal integration secret. If the value of NOTION_INTEGRATION_TYPE is "internal", you need to configure this variable.

variables.name: Dify Env: RESEND_API_URL
variables.description: API-Key for the Resend email provider, used when MAIL_TYPE is `resend`. Official default: 'https://api.resend.com'.

variables.name: Dify Env: SMTP_LOCAL_HOSTNAME
variables.description: Optional: override the local hostname used for SMTP HELO/EHLO

variables.name: Dify Env: INDEXING_MAX_SEGMENTATION_TOKENS_LENGTH
variables.description: Maximum length of segmentation tokens for indexing

variables.name: Dify Env: INVITE_EXPIRY_HOURS
variables.description: Member invitation link valid time (hours), Default: 72.

variables.name: Dify Env: WORKFLOW_LOG_CLEANUP_ENABLED
variables.description: Workflow log cleanup configuration Enable automatic cleanup of workflow run logs to manage database size

variables.name: Dify Env: WORKFLOW_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS
variables.description: Number of days to retain workflow run logs (default: 30 days)

variables.name: Dify Env: WORKFLOW_LOG_CLEANUP_BATCH_SIZE
variables.description: Batch size for workflow log cleanup operations (default: 100)

variables.name: Dify Env: WORKFLOW_LOG_CLEANUP_SPECIFIC_WORKFLOW_IDS
variables.description: Comma-separated list of workflow IDs to clean logs for

variables.name: Dify Env: LOGSTORE_DUAL_WRITE_ENABLED
variables.description: Enable dual-write to both SLS LogStore and SQL database (default: false)

variables.name: Dify Env: LOGSTORE_DUAL_READ_ENABLED
variables.description: Enable dual-read fallback to SQL database when LogStore returns no results (default: true) Useful for migration scenarios where historical data exists only in SQL database

variables.name: Dify Env: LOGSTORE_ENABLE_PUT_GRAPH_FIELD
variables.description: Control flag for whether to write the `graph` field to LogStore. If LOGSTORE_ENABLE_PUT_GRAPH_FIELD is "true", write the full `graph` field; otherwise write an empty {} instead. Defaults to writing the `graph` field.

variables.name: Dify Env: HTTP_REQUEST_NODE_MAX_BINARY_SIZE
variables.description: HTTP request node in workflow configuration

variables.name: Dify Env: HTTP_REQUEST_MAX_CONNECT_TIMEOUT
variables.description: HTTP request node timeout configuration Maximum timeout values (in seconds) that users can set in HTTP request nodes - Connect timeout: Time to wait for establishing connection (default: 10s) - Read timeout: Time to wait for receiving response data (default: 600s, 10 minutes)...

variables.name: Dify Env: TEXT_GENERATION_TIMEOUT_MS
variables.description: The timeout for the text generation in millisecond

variables.name: Dify Env: ALLOW_INLINE_STYLES
variables.description: Allow inline style attributes in Markdown rendering. Enable this if your workflows use Jinja2 templates with styled HTML. Only recommended for self-hosted deployments with trusted content.

variables.name: Dify Env: ALLOW_UNSAFE_DATA_SCHEME
variables.description: Allow rendering unsafe URLs which have "data:" scheme.

variables.name: Dify Env: SANDBOX_GIN_MODE
variables.description: The mode in which the Gin framework runs

variables.name: Dify Env: ORACLE_PWD
variables.description: Environment Variables for Oracle Service (only used when VECTOR_STORE is oracle)

variables.name: Dify Env: POSITION_TOOL_PINS
variables.description: Pin, include, and exclude tools Use comma-separated values with no spaces between items. Example: POSITION_TOOL_PINS=bing,google

variables.name: Dify Env: POSITION_PROVIDER_PINS
variables.description: Pin, include, and exclude model providers Use comma-separated values with no spaces between items. Example: POSITION_PROVIDER_PINS=openai,openllm

variables.name: Dify Env: PLUGIN_STORAGE_TYPE

variables.name: Dify Env: DATASET_MAX_SEGMENTS_PER_REQUEST
